title: Typed-command regex is anchored to the start of the turn and misses the command-message-first transcript form
detail: invocations() only counts a typed command when the text starts with command-name; the command-message-first form is skipped.
fix_hint: Accept command-name after leading command-message/command-args tags; add a fixture.

title: Subagent transcripts are counted as owner sessions and uses
detail: listTranscripts walks subagents/agent-*.jsonl, so subagent Skill calls count as owner uses.
fix_hint: Skip subagents/ dirs and isSidechain rows; test it.

title: Usage step can be bypassed silently on new runs
detail: verdict --decide after map skips usage; nothing in verdict.js checks usage.json.
fix_hint: recordDecisions refuses rebuild/use without usage.json; test the refusal.

title: An invocation without a timestamp turns every later use in the session into a hop
detail: s.prev null makes all later invocations hops.
fix_hint: Only t === null forces a hop.

title: MAX_LINE_BYTES claims lines are skipped unread
detail: readline reads the whole line; length counts code units.
fix_hint: Reword the comment and name.

title: Workflows nested more than one directory deep can never be resolved
detail: NAME allows one ':' segment.
fix_hint: Allow any number of ':' segments.

title: An evidence:none usage.json satisfies the rebuild/use gate
detail: The gate only checks usage.json exists; evidence none with no workflows still lets rebuild/use through.
fix_hint: Refuse rebuild/use when evidence is none; test it.

title: A corrupt usage.json cannot be repaired with --force
detail: recordUsage reads the prior file before checking force; corrupt JSON throws.
fix_hint: With force skip the prior read; name --force in the error.

title: usage.roots and usage.days from .claude/bbs.json are never validated
detail: A string root iterates characters; a non-number days gives NaN and a silent none.
fix_hint: Validate usage.roots and usage.days in loadConfig.

title: One unreadable transcript aborts the whole usage scan
detail: A read error on one file rejects the readline loop; the scan exits 1 and prints the path.
fix_hint: try/catch per file, count files_unreadable, continue; test it.

title: Transcripts from older Claude Code versions undercount model-invoked workflows
detail: SlashCommand tool calls (input.command) are not counted.
fix_hint: Accept SlashCommand and add it to the prefilter; fixture row.

title: Default transcript root ignores CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
detail: A moved config dir reads 0 files and the note misleads.
fix_hint: Default to $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects; name searched roots when 0 files.

title: MAX_LINE_CHARS does not limit memory
detail: readline buffers the whole line first.
fix_hint: Reword the comment.

title: usage.json records command and skill names from every project on the machine, and run folders are committed to git
detail: other keeps names of non-installed commands from all projects and the run folder is tracked.
fix_hint: Store only a count of non-installed invocations; say the scan covers every project.

title: A corrupt usage.json makes verdict --decide fail with an error that does not name the --force repair
detail: recordDecisions reads usage.json without a handler.
fix_hint: Append the cli.js usage --force hint; test it.

title: Default verdict ignores targets so Approve-as-shown dead-ends
detail: defaultVerdict/legalVerdicts keep rebuild for a power with no standing target; recordDecisions then refuses the whole batch.
fix_hint: Drop rebuild/use from legal and fall back to skip/buy when no standing target.

title: targets --from/--set rewrite landings after decisions
detail: No check that verdicts are decided; approval no longer matches stored targets.
fix_hint: Refuse once decided unless --force.

title: Prefix step match picks first of several headings
detail: checkpoint 3 matches 3 and 3b.
fix_hint: Accept prefix only when unique; else refuse with candidates.

title: Corrupt targets.json blocks skip-only decisions
detail: targets.json read before the loop regardless of decisions.
fix_hint: Read lazily only when rebuild/use present.

title: computeVerdicts throws after commit on corrupt targets/usage
detail: bare readJson for the table after verdicts.json is written; same in verdict --table
fix_hint: read inside try; warn with repair verb

title: identical resubmission refused for runs decided before targets
detail: landing check runs on repeated rows
fix_hint: skip landing check when had === v

title: targets repair hint masked by finally render
detail: renderStatusSafe rethrows bare corrupt JSON
fix_hint: catch in finally

title: targets --set '' falls through to --from
detail: truthiness vs undefined
fix_hint: branch on !== undefined; reject empty --from

title: eviction rescans capped list when saturated with KEEP rows
detail: O(cap x overflow)
fix_hint: saturated flag

title: No-evidence table says lands in no workflow next to its workflow
detail: unverified not rendered; why text wrong under evidence none
fix_hint: cause-specific why; mark unverified in landsIn

title: Table defaults to rebuild for owner-set target under no evidence; recorder refuses
detail: landingDefault and recordDecisions disagree
fix_hint: share one gate

title: Corrupt targets/usage blocks resubmitting a recorded build
detail: builds computed over all decisions
fix_hint: only over changed decisions
